scenario: LSER.14.1 — the other side of the edge: the right end of (t−W, t] is inclusive, so a sample ONE NANOSECOND short of W old is still in the window. Same steps as LSER.14.1_edge_sample_is_out_count_fires but the clock advances by 599999999999 ns. `where r.v > 1.5 and count(r.v) == 1` fires only if the t=0 sample is still counted. A runtime that evicts or goes cold one step early — `>` where the edge needs `>=`, or a window of W−1 — reads 0 and does not fire. Path: libds `series_window_emptied` (not emptied) → the ring buffer's COUNT, `trim_stale_prefix` keeping ts > t−W; Mercury `in_window`.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Float mutable

schema Warm scope logical:
    d: Int key

series Reading.v:
    count sliding 10_min

rule inside_count:
    Reading r where r.v > 1.5 and count(r.v) == 1
->
    emit Warm logical d: 0
